description: The trash bin for AI agents. Give files a lifespan and restore them from a graveyard.
notes: Obituary checks for updates at most once a day, reading only public release information. You can turn off "Check for updates automatically" in Settings or set check = false under [update] in config.toml. Privacy: https://obituary.woodfish.site/docs/en/privacy
Before removing binaries, run obit uninstall --yes in the current project; data is kept by default.
Close Obituary programs before upgrading. Keep obit.exe and obitd.exe in the same directory.
The amd64 package also includes obit-gui.exe and requires WebView2 Runtime; arm64 includes only the CLI and daemon.
